notes:
1. 文件变动监控会等待存档稳定，在读取失败后自动重试并保留最后一次变动；网络备份会先在本地完成打包，减少大型存档与 NAS 同时读写时的冲突。[#19](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/19)
2. 扫描器不再识别 UID 0、危险目录或没有精确规则的游戏安装目录，低可信结果默认关闭自动备份和同步。[#20](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/20)
3. 同一 AppID 的扫描路径会安全合并，并阻止不同游戏误用同一存档规则和重复备份同一文件；旧备份的多路径恢复保持兼容。[#20](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/20)
4. Save monitoring now waits for saves to settle, retries temporary read failures, and preserves the latest change; network backups are packaged locally first to reduce conflicts with large saves and NAS storage. [#19](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/19)
5. The scanner now rejects UID 0, unsafe directories, and install folders without precise save rules; low-confidence results keep automatic backup and sync disabled by default. [#20](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/20)
6. Scanned paths for the same AppID are safely merged, cross-game path conflicts and duplicate files are prevented, and existing multi-path backups remain compatible. [#20](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/20)
